summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Interest Income Start Date, End Date, and Current Amount features. All 10 backend API tests passed (100%). All 7 frontend UI tests passed (100%). New date fields working correctly with proper validation and backward compatibility.
critical_code_review_comments: Start Date field correctly allows past dates (no min restriction)
End Date field correctly validates against Start Date ('End date must be after start date' error)
Current Amount auto-calculation: Principal + Interest from startDate to min(today, endDate)
Matured entries (past endDate) correctly show: Yellow 'Matured' badge, End Date in yellow, Next Payment shows 'Matured'
Current Amount section displays 'Matured on [date]' for entries with past end dates
Edit mode correctly pre-fills startDate and endDate values
Backward compatibility maintained - legacy entries without dates still function correctly
Interest calculation uses correct formula: Simple Interest = P * R * T / 100, Compound Interest with proper compounding periods
seed_data_creation: Test data created and cleaned up automatically (UI_TEST_* prefixed entries)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Interest Income module now includes Start Date, End Date, and Current Amount fields. API fields: startDate (string, allows past dates), endDate (string, maturity date), currentAmount (float, auto-calculated). Frontend shows: green box with Current Amount when principal/rate/startDate filled, 'Matured' badge for past endDate entries. Backend stores all date fields correctly.
